section: 1e N=1 beta functions (contrast: manifestly supersymmetric higher-derivative regulator)
title: The four-loop beta-function from vacuum supergraphs and the NSVZ relation for N=1 SQED regularized by higher derivatives
claim: The four-loop beta-function of N=1 SQED with N_f flavours regularized by higher derivatives is obtained from vacuum supergraphs (integrals of double total derivatives, evaluated with a C++ program); the NSVZ relation is verified explicitly at four loops against the earlier three-loop anomalous dimension.
scheme: Higher covariant derivative regularization in N=1 superspace (scheme details beyond regularization not in the abstract).
symmetry_argument: Manifestly supersymmetric and gauge-invariant regulator in 4d; NSVZ for bare-coupling RG functions (cf. S1e.11_Stepanyantz2020).

proved: Explicit four-loop NSVZ check in SQED with HD regularization (abstract).

cross_checks: Consistent with the all-loop statement of S1e.11_Stepanyantz2020.
notes: Not in the brief; added as the highest-loop explicit SUSY check with a non-DR, manifestly SUSY regulator found in this sweep.
